sources.title: YOLO26-Detection - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: YOLO26-Detection Real‑time object detection optimized for mobile and edge by Ultralytics. Ultralytics YOLO26 is a machine learning model that predicts bounding boxes and classes of objects in an image. Note: YOLO26-Detection cannot be downloaded directly due to licensing restrictions. You can export a model ready for on-device deployment using the AI Hub service.
